title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server
description: PostgreSQL flexible server with one database. Entra ID is the only sign-in method (password authentication is off), closed to the internet by default, optional VNet integration and zone-redundant high availability.
security_defaults: Entra ID-only authentication: no administrator password is ever created
7-day backups; optional geo-redundant backup and zone-redundant HA

entra_admin_name.description: Display name (group / service principal) or UPN (user) of the Entra administrator.

entra_admin_object_id.description: Object ID of the Entra administrator.

sku_name.description: Compute size: B_ burstable (dev/test), GP_ general purpose, MO_ memory optimised.

storage_mb.description: Storage in MB (32 GB = 32768). Can grow, never shrink.

geo_redundant_backup_enabled.description: Copy backups to the paired region. Cannot be changed later.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Reachable from the internet. Leave false.

delegated_subnet_id.description: Subnet delegated to Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers (VNet integration). Needs private_dns_zone_id too. Cannot be changed later.

private_dns_zone_id.description: A *.postgres.database.azure.com private DNS zone linked to the VNet.

outputs.server_id: Server resource ID (target for a private endpoint, subresource 'postgresqlServer')

notes: With public access off and no delegated subnet, reach the server through a private-endpoint deployment (subresource 'postgresqlServer').
